Intraday se roz ki kamaai? SEBI ne asli data khola, aur 10 mein se 7 traders loss mein nikle.
Yeh SEBI ki study hai, FY23 ka data, equity cash segment ka.
Aur bheed badh rahi hai: 4 saal mein intraday traders, 300% se zyada badh gaye.
Inmein 30 saal se kam umar waale, 18% se badhkar 48% ho gaye.
Aur in young traders mein, 76% loss mein the.
Jitne zyada trades, utna bura: saal mein 500 se zyada trades karne waalon mein, 80% loss mein.
Aur charges alag se: loss waalon ne, apne loss ka 57%, extra mein trading costs pe diya.
Matlab ₹10,000 ka loss hua, toh kareeb ₹5,700 upar se charges mein gaye.
Toh agla trade lene se pehle, app mein poore saal ka P&L, charges ke saath, ek baar zaroor dekho.
